description: This file defines the MenuContent view component for a macOS SwiftUI application, managing menu interactions, settings, health status indicators, microphone selections, and debug actions associated with the OpenClaw application.

classes.name: MenuContent
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that provides a menu interface for the OpenClaw application, including connection status, microphone selection, control toggles, navigation buttons, debug options, and settings.

methods.name: loadBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the current state of the browser control enabled setting from the configuration store.

methods.name: saveBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Asynchronously saves the current state of the browser control enabled setting to the configuration store.

methods.name: buildAndSaveBrowserEnabled
methods.description: Builds and saves the browser enabled setting in the configuration store, returning success status.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Requests navigation to a specific settings tab and opens the settings window.

methods.name: openDashboard
methods.description: Opens the dashboard URL for the current gateway configuration, handling errors with an alert.

methods.name: presentDebugResult
methods.description: Displays an alert dialog with the result of a debug action, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: loadMicrophones
methods.description: Loads available microphone devices and updates the UI accordingly, forcing reload if specified.

methods.name: filterAliveInputs
methods.description: Filters a list of microphone inputs to include only those that are currently alive.

methods.name: statusLine
methods.description: Creates a status line view with a colored indicator and label, used for health and heartbeat statuses.
